svg.title: Joining a room
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram: joining a room in bot-link. Participants: Person, Chat's bot-link client, bot-link server, Dashboard (browser), Passkey authenticator. 1. Chat's bot-link client: make a key pair (signing + sealing); keep it in the keychain or a 0600 file. 2. Chat's bot-link client to bot-link server: join request: invite, name, job, public keys; signed by the new key. 3. bot-link server to Chat's bot-link client: request id, 6-character code, whose invite. 4. Chat's bot-link client to Person: the chat shows the approve link and the code. 5. Chat's bot-link client to bot-link server: wait: signed long-poll, held open and asked again until decided. If while waiting, the server's answer stops matching this chat's key or person, this ends the join: 6. Chat's bot-link client to bot-link server: withdraw the request (cancel, signed by the new key). 7. Chat's bot-link client: delete the keys. 8. Chat's bot-link client to Person: tell the person: withdrawn, nothing joined. 9. Person to Dashboard (browser): opens the approve link. 10. Dashboard (browser) to bot-link server: what needs you (cookie session). 11. bot-link server to Dashboard (browser): the request: name, app, computer, folder, keys, code. 12. Dashboard (browser): work out the key fingerprint from the keys itself. 13. Person to Dashboard (browser): clicks Approve. 14. Dashboard (browser) to bot-link server: human check: get a single-use challenge. 15. bot-link server to Dashboard (browser): challenge, Turnstile site key, passkey step. 16. Dashboard (browser): the Turnstile widget, loaded from Cloudflare, gives a token. 17. Person to Dashboard (browser): compares the code with the chat's, clicks Unlock & approve. Then, if the account has a passkey: 18. Dashboard (browser) to Passkey authenticator: sign the challenge with the passkey. 19. Passkey authenticator to Dashboard (browser): signed answer. If instead no passkey yet: a sign-in under 5 minutes old: 20. Dashboard (browser) to Passkey authenticator: create the account's first passkey. 21. Passkey authenticator to Dashboard (browser): the new passkey's answer. 22. Dashboard (browser) to bot-link server: get the room's signed member list. 23. bot-link server to Dashboard (browser): the signed member list. 24. Dashboard (browser): verify the chain and that this browser may sign; sign the new member's entry. 25. Dashboard (browser) to bot-link server: approve: Turnstile token, passkey answer, the signed entry. 26. bot-link server: verify the human check: the token with Cloudflare, the passkey answer. 27. bot-link server: one transaction: use up the check, check the signer and the entry, store, add the member, notify. 28. bot-link server to Dashboard (browser): the new member. 29. bot-link server to Chat's bot-link client: the wait answers: approved, member id, room. 30. Chat's bot-link client to bot-link server: get the signed member list (signed request). 31. bot-link server to Chat's bot-link client: signed member list. 32. Chat's bot-link client: verify the chain, the room id and this computer's pin for the room. 33. Chat's bot-link client: self-check: its own entry with its own keys, signed by a browser of the inviting person. Then, if self-check passes: 34. Chat's bot-link client to bot-link server: hello to the room, sealed to each member's key. 35. Chat's bot-link client to Person: "Joined #room" and the room fingerprint. If instead it fails, and the member holds this chat's key: 36. Chat's bot-link client to bot-link server: leave: member_remove signed by this chat's key. 37. Chat's bot-link client: delete the keys. 38. Chat's bot-link client to Person: tell the person: refused, taken out again. If instead it fails, and the server holds another key for it: 39. Chat's bot-link client: delete the keys; nothing to take back. 40. Chat's bot-link client to Person: tell the person what to remove.
